hook: *6* Hyderabad traders booked for hoarding PDS rice
hook_b: Ration rice hidden behind shops. Who should pay?
tldr: Officials booked six Hyderabad rice traders after finding hoarded stocks, including diverted PDS rice, behind their shops.

beats.what: Siasat: six rice traders were booked after officials found large stocks, including diverted PDS rice, in godowns hidden behind retail shops.
beats.why: PDS rice is meant for ration card holders at subsidised rates. Some of the traders also own rice mills.
beats.care: Hoarding can push up rice prices and cut supply to ration shops.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat reports the six booked traders ran shops with hidden godowns. Quantities and seized value were not in the summary.

cards.q: Ration rice is being diverted. What would stop it?
opts: Jail for traders, not just cases
Let ration shops sell more freely

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Shops in front, rice hoarded behind: 6 Hyderabad traders booked
